user.title: Describe your house
user.description: Three answers are enough to start. You can change everything later.

data_description.name: Shown as the device name, e.g. "Home" or "Granny flat".
data_description.heating_type: What heats this house. It decides how calmly Thermogeist regulates.
data_description.outdoor_temperature_entity: Any sensor measuring the outdoor temperature, e.g. a weather station or the heat pump's outdoor sensor.

details.title: Details (optional)
details.description: The more Thermogeist knows, the better it starts. Every field can stay empty.

data_description.heat_load: Heat the house needs on the coldest design day, from your heat load calculation (heating installer or energy consultant). Leave empty if unknown.
data_description.design_outdoor_temperature: The outdoor temperature your heat load was calculated for. Required if you enter a heat load. Not sure? Search the web for "design outdoor temperature" (in Germany: "Normaußentemperatur") together with your postcode.
data_description.living_area: Total heated floor area of the house, without balconies and terraces. Thermogeist uses it to estimate each room's share of the heat load from the room's size, e.g. 20 m² of 160 m² ≈ 12.5 %.
data_description.share_outside: Part of the heat load in rooms Thermogeist does not control, e.g. a bathroom with floor heating. Only needed if you know it from a heat load calculation; otherwise Thermogeist works it out from the living area. Leave empty for 0 %.
data_description.flow_temperature_entity: Optional. The heating water temperature going to the radiators, e.g. from your heat pump. Together with radiator outputs it lets Thermogeist calculate a good starting valve position.

error.design_temperature_required: A heat load needs the design outdoor temperature it was calculated for.
error.heat_load_out_of_range: Heat load must be between 0.5 and 100 kW.
error.design_outdoor_temperature_out_of_range: Design outdoor temperature must be between −40 and +10 °C.
error.living_area_out_of_range: Living area must be between 10 and 10,000 m².

user.title: Add a room
user.description: Which room, which temperature sensor, and how should Thermogeist get its share of the heat load?

data_description.name: Shown as the device name, e.g. "Living room".
data_description.area: Optional. The room device is placed in this Home Assistant area.
data_description.temperature_entity: A sensor in the room, ideally away from the radiator and out of direct sunlight.
data_description.share_mode: Most people let Thermogeist estimate it. If you have a room-by-room heat load calculation, enter the value instead.
data_description.design_indoor_temperature: Planning value from the heat load calculation, not the temperature you heat to. Usually 20 °C; bathrooms 24 °C, heated halls 15 °C. Your setpoint decides how warm the room really gets.

geometry.title: Size and position
geometry.description: Rough values are fine. Learning will correct the estimate later.

data.ceiling_low: Lowest point under a sloped ceiling

data_description.floor_area: Galleries and open spaces count their floor area once.
data_description.ceiling_height: With a sloped ceiling: the highest point.
data_description.ceiling_low: Only for sloped ceilings. Thermogeist uses the mean of lowest and highest point.
data_description.exterior_walls: Walls that face outside. A corner room usually has 2, a hallway inside the house 0.
data_description.above: What is directly above the ceiling.
data_description.below: What is directly below the floor.

known_share.title: Known share
known_share.description: Enter the room's share of the house heat load from your heat load calculation.

data_description.known_share: Room heat load divided by house heat load, in percent.

error.floor_area_out_of_range: Floor area must be between 1 and 500 m².
error.ceiling_height_out_of_range: Ceiling height must be between 1 and 12 m.
error.ceiling_low_out_of_range: The lowest point must be between 1 and 12 m.
error.ceiling_low_above_height: The lowest point cannot be higher than the ceiling height.
error.exterior_walls_out_of_range: Exterior walls must be between 0 and 4.
error.known_share_out_of_range: The share must be between 0 and 100 %.
error.known_shares_exceed_total: Together with the other rooms and the share outside Thermogeist this is more than 100 %.
error.design_indoor_temperature_out_of_range: Design indoor temperature must be between 10 and 30 °C.

user.title: Add a thermostat
user.description: Choose the room and the thermostat device. Thermogeist recognises known models and fills in the rest.

data_description.device: The thermostat device in Home Assistant (it must have a climate entity).
data_description.rated_output: Optional. The radiator's output in W at 75/65/20 °C from its data sheet or type plate. Enables the feed-forward and, later, sizing diagnostics.

reconfigure.title: Change thermostat
reconfigure.description: Choose the room and the thermostat device. Thermogeist recognises known models and fills in the rest.

data_description.device: The thermostat device in Home Assistant (it must have a climate entity).
data_description.rated_output: Optional. The radiator's output in W at 75/65/20 °C from its data sheet or type plate. Enables the feed-forward and, later, sizing diagnostics.

roles.title: What does what?
roles.description: Detected profile: {profile}. Check the entities below; empty fields are simply not used. {notes}

data_description.climate: The thermostat's own climate entity (setpoint, its temperature).
data_description.valve_read: Shows how far the valve is open.
data_description.valve_write: Lets Thermogeist set the valve position directly. Without it the thermostat is controlled by setpoint.
data_description.valve_min: A fallback stored on the device; it still works when Home Assistant is down.
data_description.external_temperature: Lets the thermostat use the room sensor instead of its own.
data_description.setpoint_source: Tells whether a setpoint was changed on the device.

error.role_needs_percent: This entity does not report a percentage. Choose the valve position entity (unit %).
error.role_needs_temperature: This entity is not a temperature input.
error.role_needs_setpoint_source: This entity does not report where a setpoint came from (manual, schedule, externally). Leave the field empty if your thermostat has none.

abort.no_rooms: Add a room first, then assign thermostats to it.
